acceptedAnswer.text: Kelby Contreras utilizes AI market analysis to identify potential investment opportunities in South Florida by detecting patterns of appreciation, rental yield potential, and development trends across various neighborhoods. The AI can highlight undervalued properties, areas poised for growth, or segments with high rental demand, often before these trends become widely apparent. This allows clients to make proactive and strategic investments in areas like Brickell, Coral Gables, or even emerging markets within Palm Beach County.
